corpus.provenance: repository-generated integer-formula P6 PPMs; no third-party media

statistics.location: paired median record/control total_ns and median stage share
statistics.uncertainty: MAD, bootstrap 95% interval over process-pair medians with fixed seed 20260818
statistics.tail: nearest-rank p95 within each content/method/lifecycle/variant stratum
statistics.multiple_comparison_rule: both methods and both lifecycles must independently pass every holdout criterion; no best-of threshold search

predictor_boundary.hypothesis: selector search plus final residual application is a stable dominant share of the complete predictor boundary, large enough to justify a future fused/resident selector+apply implementation; standalone residual dispatch is not the candidate
predictor_boundary.mechanism: non-overlapping probes around selector/search, final residual application, and nested predictor-map EncodeImageNoHuffman

acceptance.decision: accept only the broader selector+apply boundary for future implementation; never infer a residual-only opportunity

predictor_boundary.rejection: reject selector+apply if any required holdout cell fails; if predictor_map_encode reaches 35% in any required holdout cell, defer until a credible resident map-encoding boundary exists

backref_exact.hypothesis: standard exact LZ77 candidate selection is the stable dominant component of texture backward-reference selection and is therefore the smallest credible future exact-candidate acceleration boundary
backref_exact.mechanism: non-overlapping probes around standard LZ77, RLE, box, cache search/rewrite, trace-back, cost evaluation, and the inclusive backward-reference call

acceptance.decision: accept only standard exact-candidate evaluation as a future implementation boundary; preserve CPU serial choice and cache semantics

backref_exact.rejection: reject or defer if any required holdout cell fails; do not combine ratios with existing Metal hash results
